replies.author: MaxwellHowl
replies.body:
An animation means that it is non-interactive.  It is very much user controlled and interactive.  It has an increasing score for you and the opponent.  It's really only missing a win and fail state, and that's one more prompt and then it's there.

If you want to be pedantic you could call it an "interactive experience" instead of a game.  But I think most people are past that with so many art house indie games without scores or win states or traditional gameplay. This is absolutely a videogame by most modern definitions.
